description: This file defines the Base64Url utility class in the OrangeHRM project, providing static methods for URL-safe base64 encoding and decoding.

classes.name: Base64Url
classes.description: Utility class for encoding and decoding base64 strings to make them URL-safe.

methods.name: encode
methods.description: Encodes a string into a URL-safe base64 format.

methods.name: decode
methods.description: Decodes a URL-safe base64 string back to its original form.
